text:
emma: quick post-all-hands note on APAC pilot + capacity options. keeping this short for folks who asked for a single thread.
raj: can the APAC pilot include a low-latency opt-in for critical routes? we need deterministic in-region reserved capacity for some customers.
emma: yes 12 were launching an APAC low-latency pilot (reserved T4s + prewarm) for opt-in routes. pilot target mid-July; capacity and zones published next week.
lisa: billing/price for opt-in routes? teams need to estimate cost.
emma: opt-in reserved usage is billed like short-term reserved units for hosted customers; Dedicated customers can include opt-in in their commit. Console will show an estimated burn for prefill windows.
marcos: operations ask: can prefill windows be extended for holiday/sales surges? were often asked to prewarm 48-96h ahead.
emma: yes 12 prefill_window is adjustable per-route. recommended range 48-72h; ops can set up a 96h window if you give a calendar event.
jen: any simple route config teams can paste?
emma: example route snippet to copy: `route: name=search-chat, prewarm_window_h=72, prewarm_slots=40, latency_class=p95<200ms, reserve_opt_in=true`
ops-bot: notes + deck -> https://redwood.company/all-hands/2026-03-20 (deck v10.3).
emma: follow-up: scheduling 30m sync Tue 10am PT to enroll routes in the APAC pilot. DM me route names if you can't make it. thanks! :thumbsup:
